# Spotify Reimagined v0.3: TV mode, Liked Songs and Up next

## New

- **TV mode:** press **📺** in the header (or **T**). The TV and the lyrics whiteboard fill the screen, full screen where Spotify allows. Great for listening sessions or a second monitor. **Esc** to leave.
- **Liked Songs** is a gold box set at the front of your shelf, with a gold disc and every song you've liked inside.
- **Up next:** the next tracks in your queue lie as a pile of CDs beside the TV, each spine printed with the track and artist. Point at one to see it, click it to play it now.
- **Browse with the arrow keys:** no need to click the shelf first. **← →** disc by disc, **↑ ↓** row by row, **Enter** to open. In an open case, **← →** flip to the previous / next disc.
- **Repeat** on the booklet, next to shuffle, play and skip: off → repeat all → repeat one, like Spotify's own button.

## Fixed

- **Playlists over 5000 tracks** now show every track (a 9000-track playlist used to stop at 5000).
- **Turning an open case** by dragging no longer cuts the booklet page off along a diagonal.
- **"Play in the console"** can no longer overlap the hint line at the bottom, whatever your window size.
- **Clicking Notes or Lyrics** in the booklet could sometimes start a track instead. Not any more.
- **The TV corner** now renders sharp when it's playing on its own.
- **Long album titles** shrink to fit beside the booklet controls instead of being cut off.

## Faster

- No more memory build-up over long listening sessions (the console's discs and the Up next covers are now freed as they change).
- Fewer draw calls around the TV.

## Update

Run the same one-liner you installed with:

**Linux / macOS**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WhiteRafalicu/spotify-reimagined/main/install.sh | sh
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**
```powershell
iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WhiteRafalicu/spotify-reimagined/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Something off? [Open an issue](https://github.com/WhiteRafalicu/spotify-reimagined/issues/new/choose) and paste *Settings → General → Diagnostics → Copy*.
